title: HSN Putrajaya 2026 Review: What the 2025 Edition Was Like
seo_title: HSN Putrajaya 2026 Review | Hari Sukan Negara Run
meta_description: HSN Putrajaya review: about 6,200 runners at Dataran Putrajaya for National Sports Day in October 2025, and what it is like. What to expect in 2026.
dek: The Federal Territories' National Sports Day run put about 6,200 people on the roads of Putrajaya in October 2025. Here is what that edition was like, ahead of 2026.
verdict: HSN Putrajaya is the Federal Territories' National Sports Day run: a government-backed community event with a half marathon attached. The 2025 edition drew about 6,200 participants to Dataran Putrajaya in Presint 3 [1]. The minister for the Federal Territories flagged it off, and the day included aerobics, traditional games and sports demonstrations alongside the run [1]. Participants who spoke to the organisers' media described it as a family day and a way to stay active [1]. If you want a community-minded race in Putrajaya, it is a pleasant choice. It is not built as a competitive race.

sections.heading: The 2025 Edition
paragraphs: About 6,200 people took part in the National Sports Day run for Kuala Lumpur and Putrajaya at Dataran Putrajaya, Presint 3 [1]. Datuk Seri Dr Zaliha Mustafa, the minister for the Federal Territories, flagged off the run [1].
The theme for 2025 was #MalaysiaAktif, and the programme included aerobics, traditional sports and sports demonstrations for all ages alongside the run [1].

sections.heading: What Participants Said
paragraphs: A 45-year-old participant said they came with their children to spend time together being active, and that sport builds unity between communities [1]. A 60-year-old retired civil servant said sport helps them stay healthy in later life [1].
That is the spirit of the event: a family and community day, organised by the Federal Territories youth and sports department.

sections.heading: Should You Enter the 2026 Race?
paragraphs: If you live in Putrajaya or Kuala Lumpur and want a community race with a range of distances, yes.
If you want a fast, competitive half marathon, look elsewhere; the reporting on 2025 is about participation, not results or course details.
This review is compiled from published reporting on the 2025 edition, including participants' comments. It is not a first-hand race report, and nobody from this site ran the race.

faqs.question: How many people took part in HSN Putrajaya in 2025?
faqs.answer: About 6,200 participants joined the National Sports Day run for Kuala Lumpur and Putrajaya at Dataran Putrajaya, Presint 3, in October 2025. The day also included aerobics, traditional games and sports demonstrations.

faqs.question: What is HSN Putrajaya?
faqs.answer: The Federal Territories' run for Hari Sukan Negara, Malaysia's National Sports Day. It is organised by the Federal Territories youth and sports department, and in 2025 it was flagged off by the minister for the Federal Territories.

faqs.question: Is HSN Putrajaya a competitive race?
faqs.answer: It is mainly a community event. The 2025 reporting focused on participation and family activities rather than results, though the event offers timed distances up to the half marathon.
